description: Share one run. Call this only when the person asks to share. Give the run_token of the run, the snapshot the person chose to share, includes_grades as true or false, and expires_at, which is required and must be in the future. Returns share_id and a share link that opens the snapshot with the playlist's text lines, status and source until the share expires or is revoked. A run that is not verified, because the trust state of its playlist or of its school's policy is below ai_verified, is shared with the Unverified label: the answer says so, and so does the share link each time it is opened.

expires_at.description: When the share ends: a UTC timestamp in the future

includes_grades.description: Whether the snapshot carries the person's grades

run_token.description: The run_token the run's last answer returned

snapshot.description: What the person chose to share of the run; stored exactly as given

name: playlist_share
title: Playlist Share
